Definition: to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to conceive, become pregnant, bear, be with child, be conceived, progenitor; 1a)(Qal) to conceive, become pregnant; 1b) (Pual) to be conceived; 1c) (Poel) to conceive, contrive, devise
